questions.subtopic: Social Disparity Caused by Multipurpose Dams
questions.question: How have multi-purpose river projects widened the social gap between social groups in rural India?
options: Dams give free gold coins to farmers

Commercial landowners and urban industrialists reap the benefits of canal irrigation and cheap electricity, while poor tribal villagers lose their land and face displacement without adequate rehabilitation
Dams require everyone to wear identical uniforms
Dams abolish all private land ownership
questions.explanation: NCERT explains that landowners, large farmers, industrialists and some urban centres may benefit from multipurpose projects, while local people can lose land, livelihoods and access to resources. Irrigation-related changes can also widen the gap between richer landowners and landless poor. The answer is framed in terms of this unequal distribution rather than assuming every project has identical outcomes.
